label: Guide me: Tour Video

params.name: lede
params.default: Make a narrated video of any screen from its tour script - free voices, subtitles and YouTube chapters.
params.label: The cover's opening line; {product} = this edition's name

params.name: icon
params.label: The emblem on the cover (an icon name)

params.name: steps

default.title: Every screen's tour
default.say: Each row is one screen's tour script. The tag says whether its video is missing, older than its script, or up to date - change a screen's Guide me or tour and its video turns stale.

default.title: Records as you
default.say: A recording signs in as you, with a short session that ends when the video is done. Nothing to set up, and no password is kept.

default.title: Check, then record
default.say: Check steps walks the tour fast without sound, so a step that no longer points at the page shows up at once. Record video speaks each step and records the screen for a few minutes. It is free.

default.title: Take it to YouTube
default.say: Download the MP4 and its subtitles, and copy the description with the chapter times. Upload them to YouTube yourself.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
